description: UAE duo, my 4th Space Apps. I build AI tools and data pipelines (Python, React); Yannick leads design, video and storytelling. We’re on Planet X: enter sky coordinates, watch a SPHEREx time-lapse, and spot moving brown dwarfs and asteroids. Our pipeline already pulls live NASA data. We plan before we build and verify every number. Looking for: astronomy knowledge (proper motion, near-IR, variable stars), FITS/Astropy image work, or React/Aladin Lite visualisation.
